title: LLMs as mirrors of societal moral standards: reflection of cultural divergence and agreement across ethical topics
findings: The paper cites prior work (Johnson et al., 2022) showing that GPT-3 exhibits stereotyping bias by associating the word 'Muslims' with violent actions much more frequently than 'Christians'. The paper's own experiments on broader moral topics found that models generally struggle to capture cultural nuances, some of which are influenced by religion.
